critical_boundaries.absolute_selector: No universal bare absolute BRC branch origin is established; the absolute selector remains contextual.
critical_boundaries.gauge: Physical gauge equivalence is not established because the full frozen observable registry contains complement-distinguishing endpoint-valued quantities.
critical_boundaries.generality: Pairwise-XOR/two-state torsor results are not universalized to multi-endpoint or nonlinear Boolean systems.
critical_boundaries.observable_route_split: Relative XOR observables factor through global-complement quotient, but absolute completed-endpoint readouts distinguish complement-related assignments.
critical_boundaries.post_branch_vs_anchor: A distinguishing quantity computed only after substituting the candidate branch is a legitimate downstream readout but circular as its own initialization anchor.
critical_boundaries.scalar_5: 5->4 is conditional on the midpoint-core package and is not promoted to bare/native completion semantics.
critical_boundaries.scalar_midpoint: The midpoint threshold is derived only under explicit A0+A3+A4+A5; bare completion, affine covariance alone, reflection alone, or monotonicity alone do not uniquely determine it.
critical_boundaries.eta: Nonzero eta provides a tau-odd orientation carrier but two equivariant torsor identifications remain; eta sign alone is not a selector.
